title: Moving from clarinet to tenor and soprano saxophone
summary: Clarinet was his main instrument but he thought he was awful, so when saxophone came out he played tenor and soprano and put the clarinet down, which is how he went to Chicago.

blocks.x: Which did you play first, the clarinet or tenor saxophone?
The clarinet was my main instrument, but I was terrible. I was awful.
And then when the saxophone came out, then I began to play tenor so good and I took the soprano. And I played with the soprano and I didn't bother with the clarinet anymore. And I just --
